# Lower back pain

## How it happened
2024-11-18, night shift, 3:40 am. Repositioning a 118 kg patient in bed 9 with a newer RN, the slider sheet bunched up and I twisted and pulled at the same time. Felt a hot grab on the left side just above the belt line. Finished the shift on Tylenol, could barely get out of the car at home.

Filed the incident report on the unit (safety report #SR-24-1177) and the WSIB claim WS-3390817. Approved for 6 physio visits, then extended to 12.

## Diagnosis
Dr. Abernathy-Kwan, 2024-11-20: mechanical low back strain, left quadratus lumborum and erector spinae, no red flags (no leg numbness, no bladder issues, no saddle anesthesia, which I asked about because nurse brain). No imaging needed. Naproxen 220 mg twice a day with food for 7 days, heat, keep moving.

## Physio with Pilar
Dr. Pilar Ruiz-Halloran at Roncesvalles Physio & Sport, Tuesdays 7:30 am. First visit 2024-11-26. She was very direct: "Rest is the enemy here, we load it slowly."

### Phase 1 (weeks 1 to 2)
- walking 20 to 30 min twice a day
- McGill big 3: curl-up, side plank from knees 5 × 10 s each side, bird dog 6 each side with a 10 s hold
- cat-camel 10 reps, gentle
- heat pack 15 min before, not after

### Phase 2 (weeks 3 to 6)
- side plank from feet
- glute bridges 3 × 12, then single leg
- suitcase carry with a 16 kg kettlebell, 4 × 20 m each side
- back to easy running on 2024-12-14, 5 km flat, no pain

### Phase 3 (weeks 7 to 12)
- hip hinge pattern with a dowel, then trap bar
- Pilar cleared me to deadlift with a coach, which became its own project, see [[Deadlift form]]
- kettlebell swings for the hinge and the posterior chain: [[Kettlebell swings]]

## Return to work
Modified duties 2024-11-22 to 2024-12-08: no lifting over 10 kg, no bed repositioning, charge/admin and meds. Full duties from 2024-12-09. The unit got 2 more ceiling lifts in January 2025 after three of us reported similar strains, which honestly should have happened years ago.

## What I do now
- every reposition: bed at hip height, slider sheet flat, two people minimum over 90 kg, ceiling lift over 120 kg, no exceptions
- McGill big 3 before every shift, 6 minutes in the staff room. People laughed for about two weeks, now Ahmed does it too
- 15 min after shifts from [[Mobility routine]]
- deadlifts once a week, heavy but clean

## Flare-ups
- 2025-03-02: after a long drive to Ottawa (4.5 hours, no stops). Stiff for 2 days. Now I stop every 90 minutes.
- 2025-08-09: bending to weed my sister's garden for 2 hours. Mild, gone in 24 hours.
- none since

## Costs
WSIB covered the 12 physio visits. After that I kept going monthly on my own: $115 a session, 80% back from the work plan, so $23 out of pocket each time. Worth it.
